text: Session wrap-up: all five PRs from this session are merged. #5407 (TOCTOU, #5400) as 93b0acbd9, #5410 (reserved device names, #5404) as dbe4c1a7a after a real second-round finding (path_component_is_reserved_windows_device_name() only split components on '.', missing legacy MS-DOS colon-terminated device syntax like NUL:hidden.txt -- confirmed attacker-reachable in workspace_agent_target_containment.cpp, fixed in all four duplicated copies plus commented on #5405 as concrete evidence of that duplication's drift risk), #5411 (heap buffer over-read, #5402) as 265734d68 with a second previously-unreported instance fixed in file_version.cpp, #5413 (drop 'wishlist' framing per rhamenator's explicit correction -- future-facing work is real committed scope, not optional; reworded 6 issues + 6 docs) as b011711d9, and #5414 (full-codebase doc-freshness audit: 6 parallel subagents verified every scored doc in docs/31 plus the ontology/UML ground truth directly against source -- zero code bugs found, only 4 stale-doc issues fixed directly) as e51bf2dff. Branches all deleted. agent-handoff.md's continuity notes consolidated to Shipped in a follow-up PR. Also learned two standing rules this session: never direct-push to v1-development even for docs-only changes (always PR), and never frame Copperfin future-facing work as 'wishlist'/optional -- it's committed, sequenced scope.
